policy.load_priority_rule: system load first, charge second; charge is reduced to zero before an admitted system load is reduced

conclusions: battery-only operation passes the 8-A PF-R2-03 admission at the 6.0-V low-pack corner

unknown fallback contributes no assumed watts before current advertisement is measured
